slides.text: 4 tracking mistakes that make your progress look random

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid lime, no photo
slides.text:
1. only writing the weight.
example: 100 kg × 6 and 100 kg × 9 are very different sessions.

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid black, no photo
slides.text:
2. switching machines or seat settings.
if the setup changes, the numbers don't compare.

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid lime, no photo
slides.text:
3. logging after you leave.
you'll round, guess, or forget a set.

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid black, no photo
slides.text:
4. starting a set with no target.
if you don't know what to beat, you'll repeat last week.
EARND shows your previous sets and today's target before you lift, and starts the rest timer when you log a set.

slides.image_direction: BRAND BACKGROUND: solid black, no photo
slides.text:
same setup. a clear target. every set logged.
EARND launches soon. Follow for the launch.
